status: Native shaped text implemented and tested; full T04 parity remains open.
scope: Editable text on or inside saved vector paths
Fifteen preset warps with axis, bend and distortion controls
Block, Circle, Arch and Bow layouts with Dynamic Fit
Native rich-text workspace, asynchronous preview, Cancel, local layout Undo and one document transaction
Anchor-preserving text/glyph edits, native35 and Actions7 metadata
Shared text.layout API and geometry in text.create/set/state

provenance.use: Editable glyph outline approach and reuse of already translated preset formulas; upstream formulas are approximations, not Adobe algorithms.
September1,2026 guide: Block/Circle/Arch/Bow, path fit, spacing, direction and interval controls; retrieved in201.
CTLine/CTFrame shaping, actual fallback-font glyph runs and vector outlines; no new runtime dependency.
Published text operation boundary; no path/warp/Dynamic Text field or dedicated route.

photato_api.parameters: layerID, settings, optional enabled/pathID. settings replace the full layout with native defaults for omitted fields: mode, width/height, path, warp style/bend/horizontalDistortion/verticalDistortion/vertical, fit, start/end, reverse, offset, wordSpacing/lineSpacing. enabled=false removes geometry and takes no settings/pathID.
photato_api.coordinates: Logical type pixels before layer affine transform. start/end are fractions of baseline length. pathID copies document path coordinates into the logical type frame. Later saved-path edits are independent.
photato_api.state: layers[].text.geometry and capabilities.text.layout expose settings, schemas, limits, persistence and qualification.
photato_api.guards: Authentication/share/revision/interaction/locks and prepared-operation cancellation/revocation; invalid settings400; stale/busy409. Desktop and API share an atomic type command that compensates normalized bounds without moving the logical anchor or mask.

adobe_api.scope: Existing native text/job engine preserved. No dedicated shaped-text fields or endpoint in the pinned contract, so no invented Adobe route.
adobe_api.limits: Editable shaped PSD output rejects explicitly; flattened image export remains available. No Adobe output/font/composer equivalence claimed.

other_entry_points: Type tool Warp / Path Text controls
menus.shortcuts: Factory catalog retained; Warp Text has no primary shortcut.

persistence.native: Optional geometry preserves older documents; shaped metadata requires native35, created Actions require7. Older negotiated versions reject rather than omit it.
persistence.psd: Editable shaped text is rejected until its Photoshop mappings are implemented and independently qualified.

limitations: Full T04 remains open: exact Photoshop fit/composers/preset formulas and raster equality are unqualified.
Vertical shaped type and color/bitmap glyphs without vector outlines reject. Fonts and glyph/font variants require broader qualification.
The native rich-text pane edits content beside a curved preview; live curved caret/IME and direct draggable path delimiters are deferred.
Saved paths are copied; not live-linked. Semantic Actions recording of arbitrary type edits, full PSD forms and cross-application interchange remain open.
Synthetic/offscreen AppKit and host tests only; no unlocked desktop, independent Photoshop output or physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 qualification.

tests.status: Passed focused and full optimized qualification.
